features.title: Open Jujutsu references from a chat message
features.summary: Inline code in a message becomes a link when it is an explicit JJ identity — a revision-shaped token, a repository bookmark, or a `jj:`-prefixed name — hovering it previews a bounded revision graph around it — its neighbourhood plus the working copy, main, main@origin and the default workspace — and clicking it opens the side panel on the Session repository, focused on that revision or comparing it with main/default along its history path. The `jj:` prefix is the writing convention Agents are told to use, and the reader sees the bare name.
reach: expect text "Open Jujutsu refs from chat"
expect text "Compare with main/default and show history path"

configuration.constraints: Boolean; link explicit inline-code revision ids, repository bookmarks and `jj:`-prefixed names in chat.
One of focus or path; path compares against main/default and shows ancestry.

failureModes: Ordinary inline code and another thread's conversation are never rewritten.
A reference that is not in the loaded graph page falls back to the graph search.
Without a link owner (the plugin is not loaded) native inline code stays inert text.

externalDependencies.boundary: Local bookmark names read through the composer context query; the reference must appear in a rendered message.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: A real scratch jj repository with a `main` bookmark, and a Command Code account on the loopback fake provider answering `[[answer …]]` so the code span is deterministic.
